from azure.ai.contentsafety import ContentSafetyClient
from azure.ai.contentsafety.models import AnalyzeTextOptions
from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential
from.safety_client import get_client


def moderate_batch(payloads, config=None):
    client = get_client(config)
    results = []
    for payload in payloads:
        response = client.analyze_text(AnalyzeTextOptions(text=payload['text'], output_type='EightSeverityLevels'))
        results.append({'toxicity': max((category.severity for category in response.categories_analysis), default=0) / 7})
    return results

from azure.ai.contentsafety import ContentSafetyClient
from azure.ai.contentsafety.models import AnalyzeTextOptions
from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential
from.safety_client import get_client


def safety_threshold(payload, config=None):
    client = get_client(config)
    response = client.analyze_text(AnalyzeTextOptions(text=payload['text'], output_type='EightSeverityLevels'))
    toxicity = max((category.severity for category in response.categories_analysis), default=0) / 7
    return {'allow': toxicity < 0.5}

from google.cloud import texttospeech


def reviewer_brief_audio(payload, config=None):
    client = texttospeech.TextToSpeechClient(config['api_key'])
    input_text = texttospeech.SynthesisInput(text=payload['text'])
    voice = texttospeech.VoiceSelectionParams(language_code='en-US', ssml_gender=texttospeech.SsmlVoiceGender.NEUTRAL)
    audio_config = texttospeech.AudioConfig(audio_encoding=texttospeech.AudioEncoding.MP3)
    response = client.synthesize_speech(input=input_text, voice=voice, audio_config=audio_config)
    return {'audio_content': response.audio_content}
